Priya,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. We are ready to move forward but need to lock a couple of commercial mechanics before legal will sign the order form. Two asks from procurement/finance: 

1) Milestone-based invoicing: We need explicit language for activation and milestone invoices. Our preference is: 50% on activation (signed SOW/order form + go-live), then monthly invoicing against consumption with a 30-day net term. Can you confirm Redwood can accept a 50/50-style activation + monthly consumption split?

2) Tax/VAT treatment: Stellate is EU-headquartered and we'd like the order form to explicitly allow reverse-charge where applicable. We also need a short checklist of evidence (VAT number, signed order form, invoice templates) so our finance team can process VAT correctly.

Other items: currency (USD ok), need to see the redline PDF from you so we can route to our legal. Also want to confirm there are no minimum commit thresholds that would block monthly consumption billing.

Can you loop in whoever owns tax/legal on your side? Hoping to get this wrapped this week so we can cut a PO.

Thanks,
Alicia

Priya / Alicia — looping legal in with a proposed clean clause. I kept the language compact to avoid endless back-and-forth.

Proposed insertion for "Invoice Triggers":
"Commencement Invoice: A one-time invoice equal to fifty percent (50%) of the Order Form value shall be issued upon Commencement, defined as the effective date of the Order Form and confirmation of go-live criteria. Thereafter, Redwood will invoice monthly in arrears for metered usage and over-usage in accordance with the Pricing Schedule. Unless otherwise agreed in writing, all invoices are payable Net 30 days from the invoice date."

Proposed insertion for "Tax and Withholding":
"Taxes: Customer is responsible for all taxes, duties and levies associated with its purchase, excluding taxes based on Redwood's net income. For customers subject to EU reverse-charge rules, Customer shall provide a valid VAT identification number and any required tax documentation; Redwood will not collect VAT where Customer has provided appropriate evidence and reverse charge applies. Redwood may request reasonable supporting documentation prior to issuing a reverse-charge-exempt invoice."

Ben — on the billing side, confirm whether Net30 is operationally feasible (we currently default Net45 for some enterprise deals). If Net30 is acceptable without additional underwriting, we can reflect that in the order form.

Alicia — if Stellate requires Net45 we can propose an exception (and note it in the invoice appendix) but we prefer Net30 as standard.

-Kim
